sec-head.h2: When custom model hosting is NOT the right choice

p: Custom model hosting excels for data privacy, low latency, and domain specialization. But if your use case requires minimal customization, rapid prototyping, or variable workloads, OpenAI's API provides faster iteration and lower upfront infrastructure overhead. The decision hinges on long-term cost scale, regulatory requirements, and internal MLOps maturity.

faq-item.faq-q: When should I choose Hugging Face over OpenAI for custom models?
faq-item.faq-a: Choose Hugging Face when you need data sovereignty, sub-500ms inference latency, or deep model customization. OpenAI is better for rapid prototyping, variable loads, and teams without ML infrastructure.

faq-item.faq-q: How do I compare costs between self-hosting and API usage?
faq-item.faq-a: Self-hosting has higher upfront GPU cost but lower per-token price at scale. A detailed cost model includes inference volume, batch size, GPU type, and energy costs to find your break-even point.

faq-item.faq-q: Can I fine-tune open weights models for my specific industry?
faq-item.faq-a: Yes, open-weight models like Llama 3.1 or Mistral can be fine-tuned on proprietary data using LoRA or full-parameter methods, achieving domain-specific accuracy comparable to proprietary APIs.

faq-item.faq-q: Do I need an agency or can an independent engineer build this?
faq-item.faq-a: Working directly with a specialized independent engineer ensures direct accountability, faster decisions, and lower costs without agency overhead layers or account management fees.

faq-item.faq-q: How much does custom model hosting cost to implement?
faq-item.faq-a: A scoped proof-of-concept starts at $3,000 to $7,000. Full production deployment with fine-tuning, inference, and monitoring typically ranges from $15,000 to $50,000 depending on model size and infrastructure needs.
